description: This file contains the implementation of a JSON serialization codec for Orleans, including the JsonCodec class, options, and extension methods for configuring JSON serialization.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A codec that serializes and deserializes objects to/from JSON for Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: JsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for JSON serialization, including custom type filters and JSON serializer settings.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for adding JSON serialization support to Orleans serializer builder.

methods.name: JsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON codec with selectors and options.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object (not implemented).

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks whether a type is supported for cloning.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a JSON value from the buffer.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Filters to determine if a type is allowed for serialization.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization.

methods.name: JsonCodecOptions
methods.description: Holds various JSON serializer, reader, writer options, and type filtering functions.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add JSON serializer with custom type filters to the serializer builder.
